_comment: Independent one-year 15-minute optimizer for MTF Confluence Lean. Chart TF 15m; each filter still reads its own timeframe. Same 19-coin universe as the 5m tree.  REALISM PASS 2026-08-12: fixed $1000 cash per trade (qty_pct_equity removed from the search space and pinned to 0), initialCapital raised 1000 -> 10000 so $1000/trade is a genuine 10% slice that is always affordable (at 1000 capital a $1000 order was still 100% of the account, which is what we were moving away from), commission 0.1% PER SIDE (= 0.2% round trip, matching Binance spot taker fees), slippage 0 -> 2 ticks. These match the Pine script's own strategy() declaration: initial_capital=10000, default_qty_value=1000, strategy.cash. NOTE: slippage is per-TICK so its % cost varies by symbol (RIFUSDT ~0.217% vs ZECUSDT ~0.004% for the same 2 ticks).  IS/OOS 2026-08-12: range.split is the in-sample/out-of-sample boundary. The GA only ever scores the IS window; OOS metrics are computed from the same run and carried on every record so curve-fitted configs are visible as an IS->OOS collapse.
